doc: ColorPicker lets the user pick a color interactively within a color area, a hue bar and an optional alpha bar, or by entering it in one of several notations.

4.doc: Value is the current color as hex, either #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.
4.name: Value

5.doc: InputValue is a binding to a state, into which the picked color is written as hex.
5.name: InputValue

9.doc: DisableAlpha hides the alpha bar, so that only opaque colors can be picked.
9.name: DisableAlpha

11.doc: Id represents an optional identifier to locate this component within the view tree. It must be either empty or unique within the entire tree instance.
11.name: Id
